clinicInfo.name: B-Smart Dental Clinic & Implant Centre
clinicInfo.address: Savalanga Road, 1st Main Road, Gandhi Nagar, Shivamogga, Karnataka 577201, India
clinicInfo.emergencyNotice: For urgent dental pain or emergencies during clinic hours, contact our clinic hotline directly at +91 94825 84402.

dentists.name: Dr. Srinidhi Bhat
dentists.biography: Experienced practitioner focusing on comprehensive oral health, gentle surgical techniques, and durable implant-supported prosthetics in Shivamogga.

services.name: General Dental Consultation
services.description: Comprehensive clinical oral examination, digital intraoral assessment, treatment roadmap, and preventative oral health recommendations.

services.name: Dental Implants
services.description: Permanent, titanium-root dental replacements engineered to restore masticatory function, natural aesthetics, and preserve underlying jaw bone structure.

services.name: Teeth Cleaning & Scaling
services.description: Ultrasonic scaling to safely remove calculus (tartar), stubborn plaque, and extrinsic stains, maintaining gingival health and fresh breath.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
services.description: Precision endodontic therapy to eliminate root canal infection, alleviate toothache, and save severely decayed or traumatized natural teeth.

services.name: Dental Crowns & Bridges
services.description: Custom ceramic and zirconia restorations fabricated to rebuild fractured teeth, reinforce root canal-treated teeth, and bridge edentulous gaps.

services.name: Tooth Extraction
services.description: Gentle, minimally invasive dental extraction for non-restorable, fractured, or problematic wisdom teeth with proper local anaesthesia and postoperative guidance.

services.name: Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Enhancement
services.description: Aesthetic tooth bonding, diastema closures, and composite veneers to harmonize your smile aesthetics.

services.name: Gum Care & Periodontics
services.description: Specialized periodontal therapeutic care for bleeding gums, gingivitis, and periodontal pocket management.

services.name: Dentures (Complete & Partial)
services.description: Custom-crafted removable complete and partial dentures designed for chewing comfort and facial contour restoration.

services.name: Preventive Dental Care & Sealants
services.description: Protective dental sealants, professional fluoride varnishes, and habitual maintenance for long-term oral protection.
